purpose: Connect a real fact to an outcome that contradicts expectation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
I slept enough. Even so, I am still sleepy.
I practiced many times. Nevertheless, I made a mistake in the performance.
The forecast said it would be sunny. Yet it has rained since morning.
restrictions: Refers back to the whole preceding circumstance.
mistake: Do not use it when the second result naturally follows the first.

segments.role: Connect a real fact to an outcome that contradicts expectation. Sentence + それなのに + sentence

examples.translation: I slept enough. Even so, I am still sleepy.
examples.note: A condition fails to yield the expected result.
